description: Before git push, gh pr create or gh release create, verify the evidence the repository declares at HEAD. A failed check denies the call; nothing declared asks, marked NOT MEASURED.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/proofbundle_gate.py" || { echo 'proofbundle gate: the gate could not run, so the call is blocked' >&2; exit 2; }
